---
title: Home
---

This example is shaped to be **opened in the Quarto Hub web
client**, not just rendered to disk. It exercises the live preview
path: when you edit a file in the hub editor, the preview iframe
re-renders the active page **with the project's full website
chrome** — sidebar, navbar, prev/next, cross-doc links — instead
of just the bare body.

The hub-client invokes a WASM build of Quarto under the hood. Its
preview entry point is `render_page_in_project`: it does the same
project discovery `quarto render` does, runs Pass 1 across all
files in the project (cache-warm via IndexedDB after the first
edit), then renders only the active page in Pass 2.

See [About](about.qmd) and the [first post](posts/first.qmd).
